bis(2-(((1-benzyl-1H-1,2,3-triazol-4-yl)methyl)(methyl)amino)- 
3,3,3-triﬂuoropropanoate) (5b) 
The compound was synthesized according to the general proce- 
dure. Yield 73% as a pale orange oil (eluent petroleum ether/ethyl 
acetate = 5/1), as a mixture of diastereomers A and B at the ra- 
tio 1:1. Mixture of Z/E isomers in ratio of ~1:1. 1 H NMR (400 MHz, 
CDCl 3 ) δ 7.46-7.43 (m, 2H), 7.
